title: Remove the owner-merges label so agents merge every story on green
seam: owner-merges lines of baselines/BASE_CLAUDE.md, docs/PRDs/PRD.md, docs/guide/index.html and the skill files
story: Agents used to stop at a green pull request and wait for the owner whenever a story carried the owner-merges label. That label no longer exists: /dev-next now merges every story it builds once checks are green, apart from the person-merges cases (PRD, ADR, prototype, CLAUDE.md, outside-change).
no_qa_reason: Rules and skill text only; nothing a user drives, and a suite check guards it.
